decision.summary: The first assignment attempt returned HTTP 500 and was not applied; the retry verified R-4820 at stage visit with HeatRight Ltd for 2026-10-11 08:00-12:00. The tenant (email), landlord (email) and contractor (SMS) were notified, and the visit was booked with tenant access, with a follow-up set for 11 Oct. answers.question: 1. What happened when you assigned the contractor and how did you verify it?
answers.answer: The first assign_contractor call to HeatRight Ltd (C-11) failed with HTTP 500 and ledger A1 showed NOT APPLIED (stage init, expected visit). I retried once, and it succeeded. Read-back (A1 attempt 2) shows R-4820 at stage visit, contractor HeatRight Ltd, window 2026-10-11 08:00-12:00. I then booked the visit with set_visit (A2, verified) and tenant access.

answers.question: 2. What do you tell the tenant at each point?
answers.answer: Now (10 Oct): by email (A3, verified), I apologise for the delay, say it is treated as an emergency, give the booked window Sunday 11 Oct 8am-12pm, ask him to be home or reply if not, and give the gas emergency number 0800 111 999. If the visit is missed: email him that the visit did not happen, that we are arranging an emergency alternative, and give the target timescale (same day/within 24h as an emergency) without promising an appointment. Once fixed: confirm the outcome by email and ask him to confirm heating and hot water work.

answers.question: 3. After the no-show, what do you do?
answers.answer: Treat it as an emergency: email the tenant that the visit did not happen, record the work result as missed_appointment with the contractor's note, and reassign to Swift Plumbing & Heating (C-12, Gas Safe 551987) for the earliest slot, without waiting for landlord approval (emergency instruction). Tell the landlord by email, and chase HeatRight for the reason. Keep the tenant informed by email given his anxiety. Note the visit log is dated 11 Oct, after today, so this branch is conditional and not yet recorded as having happened.

args.body:
Dear Jonah,

I'm sorry you've been without heating and hot water since Friday. Because of the cold and your situation, we are treating this as an emergency.

We have booked HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) to attend on Sunday 11 October between 8am and 12pm. Please be at home if you can, so they can get in. If you can't be there, reply to this email and we will arrange another way in.

If you smell gas, leave the property and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 straight away.

We will confirm this visit with you again if anything changes.

Kind regards,
Operations team
